proposals.evidence: DEDR 3684 records singular Tamil nī, Kannada nīnu, Kodagu nīnï, Gondi immā/nimma, Kui īnu, Kurux/Malto nīn and Tulu ī. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
